STMP.description: System Temperature (STMP). Defines a uniform system temperature load referencing an existing static load case (LCNAME) and optionally a load group (GROUP_NAME); the key is the load case identifier.

TEMPER.description: System temperature value applied uniformly to the whole model for this load case.

LCNAME.description: Name of an existing static load case this temperature is assigned to. Must resolve to an existing load case; assigning a non-existent name is rejected.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the load group. Empty string means no load group; a non-empty value must resolve to an existing load group or the request is rejected.
